result.description: AI image and video generation platform; exposes a pay-as-you-go async REST API over 50+ generative models, plus an MCP server and CLI.
result.auth_detail: REST API: key ID + secret pair sent as 'Authorization: Key ID:SECRET' (legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers also accepted). Docs mention no OAuth for the REST API. The hosted MCP server and CLI use a browser sign-in/authorization flow tied to a user account (OAuth-style per secondary sources, not confirmed by vendor text). It needs a paid subscription and is a separate product from the API.
result.access_detail: Anyone can sign up for an API account (individual or company), then register a payment method and fund a prepaid USD balance. Billing is pay-as-you-go with a $5 minimum top-up and no plan or subscription. There is no free tier, but access is open and self-serve. MCP and CLI need an active paid subscription instead.
result.api_notes: One authenticated, asynchronous API for generating images and videos. Submit a request to a per-model endpoint, then poll status by request ID. 50+ models. Python and TypeScript SDKs are available. It is a generation-only surface, with no broad account or project object management.
result.blocker: API requires prepaid funding ($5 minimum), with no free tier. Auth is a key ID + secret pair, so OAuth2 is not offered for the REST API. The OAuth-style MCP/CLI path needs a paid subscription. The API surface is generation-only.

evidence.quote: Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5.
Sign up for an API account, either as an individual or as a company.
Generate images and videos through one authenticated, asynchronous API.
One API key unlocks every model in the API catalog: 50+ current video and image models,
Name it Higgsfield and paste the MCP server URL: `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`
An active paid subscription is required.
Authenticate: run `higgsfield auth login` and complete the sign-in in the browser it opens.
No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog,
